Why Aravian Financial

Mortgage Expertise
Without Compromise.

As an independent broker, we work for you — not the bank. That means access to more lenders, more programs, and more personalized service at every step.

I  —  Independent Advantage
Access More Lenders

We shop your loan across dozens of wholesale lenders to find the most competitive rate and terms — something a single bank simply cannot offer.

II  —  Direct Access
Your Originator, Always

You work directly with Kris Syevens from application to close. No hand-offs, no call centers — just clear, responsive communication you can count on.

III  —  Texas-Focused
Local Market Knowledge

From DFW to Houston to the Hill Country, we understand the Texas market and bring specialized knowledge in state-specific programs like TSAHC (Down Payment Assistance).

IV  —  Full Suite
Every Loan Program

Whether you're a first-time buyer, veteran, self-employed, or seasoned investor — we have a loan program designed for your unique situation.

Client First. Always.

From the first conversation
to handing you the keys.

Loan Programs

Every Borrower.
Every Situation.

We offer a comprehensive range of residential mortgage programs. Not sure which fits you? We'll help you find out.

Conventional
Most Popular

Flexible financing with competitive rates for buyers with solid credit and stable income. Available in fixed and adjustable-rate terms.

Learn More →
FHA
Low Down Payment

Government-backed loans ideal for first-time buyers or those with lower credit scores. As little as 3.5% down.

Learn More →
VA
Veterans & Military

Exclusive benefits for eligible veterans and active-duty service members — including $0 down and no PMI.

Learn More →
Jumbo
High-Value Properties

Financing beyond conventional loan limits for luxury homes and high-cost markets with competitive terms.

Learn More →
USDA
Rural & Suburban

Zero-down financing for eligible rural and suburban properties — often overlooked, always worth exploring.

Learn More →
Non-QM & More
Self-Employed & Investors

Bank statement, DSCR, asset-based, and other alternative programs for borrowers outside traditional guidelines.

The Process

Simple. Transparent.
Straightforward.

We've streamlined the mortgage process so you always know exactly where you stand.

01
Consultation

We start by learning your goals, timeline, and financial picture — no pressure, no commitment.

02
Pre-Approval

We pull your credit, review your documents, and issue a strong pre-approval so you can shop with confidence.

03
Loan Selection

We compare options across our lender network and present the best program and rate for your needs.

04
Processing

We manage your file from submission through underwriting, keeping you informed at every milestone.

05
Closing

You sign, we fund, you get the keys. It's that simple — and we're here for your next loan too.

across the great state of Texas.
